title: A Boar in Camp
text: A wild boar charges into camp at night. After a brief scuffle there is meat for a week.

title: The Forester's Trail
text: In the morning someone finds fresh boot prints around the camp. The count's forester knows where you are.

title: A Song about the Band
text: At the crossroads inn they already sing about your band. The men are proud, though it is dangerous.

title: Downpour in the Woods
text: Rain pours all night. The shelters leak and the fire goes out every hour.

title: Peasants with a Basket
text: Peasants from a nearby village bring bread and cheese. They remember who chased off the tax collector.

title: A Quarrel over the Share
text: Two outlaws quarrel over a purse from the last robbery. Knives come out before the chief separates them.

title: A Fugitive from Town
text: A prisoner on the run walks into camp. For a place by the fire they give everything they have.

title: Wolves in the Night
text: The howling of wolves does not stop until dawn. Nobody sleeps and the watch changes every hour.

title: Treasure under a Root
text: Digging a refuse pit, someone hits a rotten box with a few coins in it.

title: A Wanted Poster at the Inn
text: A scout brings back a torn wanted poster. The description of the chief is surprisingly accurate.

title: Taal's Feast
text: The band keeps Taal's feast under an old oak. Tonight the forest seems friendly.

title: A Lost Satchel
text: Someone left a satchel of food by the stream. By morning only fox tracks remain.

title: A Stranger in the Woods
text: The sentry hears someone circling the camp.
okText: The scout comes up behind the intruder. It is only a lost shepherd, but they know where the hunters are camped.

title: A Stag at the Clearing
text: At dawn a stag steps into the clearing. One shot and there will be meat.
okText: The poacher does not miss. The band eats its fill for the first time in a week.

title: Marsh Fever
text: After a night by the marsh several men shake with chills and fever.
okText: The hedge healer brews willow bark and the fever breaks by noon.

title: A Drunken Giant
text: A drunken woodcutter staggers into camp looking for a fight.
okText: The bruiser hoists him over a shoulder and carries him back to the woods. Everyone laughs.

title: Shelter in an Old Adit
text: You find a dry, forgotten mine adit in the cliff face. For the first time in days everyone sleeps out of the wind.

title: Pass Guard Toll
text: Toll guards look the other way at outlaws camping in the hollow in return for a quiet "tribute".

title: Dwarf Muleteer
text: A lone dwarf with a laden mule shares your fire and pays silver for an escort down the ridge.

title: Rockslide on the Trail
text: A night rockslide blocks the path behind camp. You have to take a detour over slick scree.

title: Friendly Innkeeper
text: A landlord on the outskirts hides the band in his barn and slips you word of a wealthy merchant.

title: Lost Nobleman’s Hunt
text: A young lordling gets lost with his hounds in the thicket. He hands over his signet ring and purse to be led back to the road.

title: Treacherous Valley Fog
text: White fog hangs in the valley until noon. Two riders lose the path and return empty-handed at dusk.

title: Charcoal Burner’s Cart
text: An old charcoal burner yields a cart of salted pork and groats without a fight, valuing his skin more than cargo.

title: Thief in Camp
text: One of the newer recruits sneaks into the shared larder at night. He gets the lash, but ill feeling lingers.

title: Smokeless Fire
text: Old hands teach the young ones to burn dry alder beneath an overhang. The night passes warm and unseen.

title: Road Warden Patrol
text: Cloaked Road Wardens ride past the thicket twenty paces from camp. Someone may have caught a glint of steel.

title: Cache of an Old Band
text: Under the collapsed roof of a forester’s hut you uncover a buried stash of silver and hardtack.

title: Recognised at the Gate
text: At the town gate one of the watchmen stared a little too long at your follower’s scars.

title: Snooper by the Highroad
text: Someone at the roadside tavern is asking pointed questions about tracks leading into the woods.
okText: The shadow corners the informer in the dark, lifts his purse and sends him down a false trail.

title: Brawl at the Crossroads
text: Several followers started a drunken brawl at the inn and the watch will be here any minute.
okText: The provocateur turns the row into a fairground jest, buys the watchman a pint and picks up news of a convoy.

title: Burned Merchant Wagon
text: On a side trail lies a wagon stripped yesterday by another band.
okText: The scavenger pries up the false floorboards and pulls out intact hardtack and a hidden coin pouch.

title: Crossing the Swollen Ford
text: The river has risen and cut off your escape route with the loot.
okText: The smuggler remembers an old sunken stone ford and leads men and pack animals across without losing a strap.

title: Posse on Your Heels
text: An armed posse has camped half a mile away and plans to ride down your trail at dawn.
okText: The saboteur saws through their supply wagon axles in the night and scatters their horses. The pursuit stalls.

title: Greedy Village Fence
text: A local middleman threatens to tip off the bailiff unless you slash your asking price.
okText: The fixer reminds him of forged receipts bearing his mark; the trader pays in full and adds a sack of grain.

title: Challenger in Camp
text: A runaway cutthroat tries to win over the younger outlaws and seize command.
okText: The duelist disarms him in three cuts before the whole band. Order snaps back into place.

title: Wounded Peddler by the Road
text: A beaten peddler lies in the ditch beside a smashed cart. The band debates whether to patch him up or take his boots.

title: The Peddler’s Gratitude
text: The grateful peddler steals back by night with a crate of spirits and the exact route of tomorrow’s tax coach.

title: Road Warden Hounds
text: Hounds bay along the ravine in the dark. Trackers have picked up your trail from the last hold-up.

title: False Trail in the Gorge
text: Pepper-baited snares and a false scent send the posse crashing into the wrong gorge, leaving spare packs behind.
